quotes.text: Learn how to migrate to version 4.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK.

old_evidence.text: Update your minimum supported version to iOS 14 or higher
Auto reconnection is now enabled by default for mobile and Tap to Pay readers
the `ReaderReconnectionListener` has been inherited by the respective ReaderListeners.
now also cancels any ongoing payment processing.

findings: The 2026-11-07 capture is the Terminal SDK 4.0.0 variant index for iOS and Android. It does not contain implementation instructions or a third platform variant.

The 2026-05-01 capture is the complete combined version 4.0.0 migration guide for existing iOS and Android integrations, despite the old filename. It documents connection and discovery changes, consent parameters, cancelable confirms and platform differences.

Preserve distinct consent paths: an existing in-person PaymentIntent save-after-payment integration passes setup_future_usage at creation and collects with allow_redisplay. For direct SetupIntent collection the old customerConsentCollected parameter is replaced by allowRedisplay.

The November index's iOS and Android links are navigation only, with .md platform URLs. Its omission of functional text cannot establish removal, reversal or introduction of SDK behavior. The stored diff joins the old end line to the new iOS link at one boundary; the pinned new file lines 13-14 establish the two distinct links.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain iOS 14+ for the move to v4, with iOS 13+ still documented for existing iOS SDK 3.x; keep Android's separate Tap to Pay Maven coordinates and collection timeout specific to Android Tap to Pay, not all Terminal flows.

Keep discovery supersession and immediate start of the new discovery, smart/Tap to Pay completion callbacks, reader-type ConnectionConfiguration and callbacks, and default reconnection specifically for mobile and Tap to Pay after unexpected disconnect. Preserve separately sourced newer major-version requirements.

The prior guide's smart-reader MOTO is preview with a request-access route at that date. Keep this a dated raw locator. Cancelable confirmations and intent cancellation stopping ongoing processing are historical mobile SDK v4 behaviors.
conflicts: The source and broad routing labels can imply all readers auto-reconnect by default. Preserve the old guide's mobile and Tap to Pay, unexpected-disconnect scope.

The source says Android ReaderReconnectionListener was removed. It was removed as a standalone configuration parameter but continues to supply inherited events on respective listeners. iOS SCPReconnectionDelegate was removed and its responsibilities moved.

The source compresses PaymentIntent and SetupIntent consent into a common replacement and describes intent cancellation as stopping collection alone. Clarify the two consent paths and the old guide's ongoing-processing scope. The Android predecessor artifact name in the source is not given in the matched raw; the pin establishes only the required new coordinate and that the old artifact stops receiving updates.

findings: Retain the May 1 behavioral raw and existing inbound stripe-terminal, Stripe provider-index and company routes. Add the separate November 7 iOS/Android navigation raw and a source-to-stripe-terminal link to complete the reciprocal route. The pinned source lists only the May raw at lines 47–49 and contains no concept link. Qualify auto-reconnect excerpts to mobile and Tap to Pay after unexpected disconnect.
conflicts: Correct the historical consent, reconnect/listener and intent-cancellation wording with the May evidence. Keep the old Maven artifact unnamed unless separately sourced.
source_assessments.reason: November is a platform index. The useful update is to add its routes while preserving the complete older factual authority and correcting existing overstatements.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/references/sdk-v4-migration-guide, source-stripe-terminal-sdk-v4-migration-guide should distinguish the 2026-11-07 iOS and Android navigation index (new raw lines 5-14) from the 2026-05-01 guide for applications upgrading from prior iOS/Android SDKs to 4.0.0 (old raw lines 24-34 and old raw lines 250-254). The index gives platform routes without stating migration prerequisites, SDK actors or transitions. The full May guide requires iOS 14+ for v4 and describes PaymentIntent saving with setup_future_usage at creation plus allow_redisplay at collection, compared with the direct SetupIntent replacement of customerConsentCollected by allowRedisplay (old raw lines 30-50 and old raw lines 256-269). It adds the discovering state; a second discovery cancels the old operation and begins immediately. connectReader takes the reader type's configuration, and unexpected disconnect triggers default reconnection for mobile and Tap to Pay readers (old raw lines 52-72 and old raw lines 123-129 and old raw lines 271-291 and old raw lines 348-354). With auto-reconnection enabled, if reconnection fails and the reader disconnects, the per-reader listener or delegate receives both failure and disconnect callbacks (old raw lines 184-188 and old raw lines 408-412). The SDK provides cancelable confirmations. Its cancelPaymentIntent and cancelSetupIntent methods also stop ongoing payment processing (old raw lines 236-241 and old raw lines 448-452). The current summary captures these topics but compresses consent paths, generalizes the reconnect default and calls the Android reconnection listener removed where the old guide says its events are inherited.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/references/sdk-v4-migration-guide, record source-stripe-terminal-sdk-v4-migration-guide's November date and iOS and Android .md variant URLs (new raw lines 9-14). The format and routing change from combined implementation detail and embedded platform entry points (old raw lines 24-28 and old raw lines 250-254). The omitted details remain sourced to the 2026-05-01 capture (old raw lines 1-2 and new raw lines 1-3). Preserve v4-specific iOS 14+ versus earlier SDK 3.x iOS 13+ and the earlier smart-reader MOTO preview (old raw lines 16-22 and old raw lines 28-34). Scope reconnect to unexpected disconnects for mobile/Tap to Pay, and distinguish the removed iOS delegate from Android's inherited reconnection interfaces and replaced configuration parameter (old raw lines 123-129 and old raw lines 348-354 and old raw lines 469-474). Scope Android's 60-second timeout to the two Tap to Pay collection methods (old raw lines 454-459). The May Android section names the required v4 Maven coordinate com.stripe:stripeterminal-taptopay:4.0.0 and says the predecessor artifact will stop receiving updates. It does not name the predecessor, so the specific stripeterminal-localmobile name in the summary needs separate evidence. See old raw lines 469-474. The source currently links only the May behavioral raw and has no concept link (lines 47–49). Retain its May raw and the existing inbound stripe-terminal concept, provider index and company links. Add the distinct November navigation raw and a source-to-stripe-terminal link to make the concept route reciprocal. If auto-reconnect remains in routing excerpts, specify mobile and Tap to Pay readers after an unexpected disconnect. Keep the separately versioned later migration guide and SetupIntent consent-policy routes distinct. These pins do not establish the current SDK release.
